text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah!
Windy-chan is in top form!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
On my day off yesterday, I went back home!
And then, and then—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
My moms showered me with tons of praise!
They said Windy-chan's doing an amazing job!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: And then! Papa made a whole bunch of Windy-chan's favorite foods! It was the ab-so-lute best vacation ever~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy had a deeply fulfilling day off and seems thoroughly refreshed!
